dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: I wasn't looking where I was going...

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: Sunny street, midday. Cafes line the background. Tori walks with coffee in hand, distracted by her Tamagotchi.

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: Oh my gosh, I'm so sorry... I wasn't paying attention!

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She bumps into an older man. Both their Tamagotchis tumble to the ground. Hers scuffs, his looks worn, modified.

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: ...Weird. Mine has never done that before.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She bends down, picks up his Tamagotchi by mistake. The toy buzzes in her hand.
